title: SMIC: Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning across Transformer Layers for Natural Language Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.16270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural Language Inference models can be sensitive to localized lexical changes. We introduce Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning (SMIC), which constructs a single input-dependent multiscale reference and reuses it across Transformer layers. Each layer applies its own multiscale transformation to the shared reference and injects the resulting conditioning feature before the attention update. We instantiate SMIC in a token--context Transformer (TCT) and conduct from-scratch comparisons against decoder-based and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) baselines across all three ANLI rounds. TCT-SMIC attains the highest observed ten-seed mean accuracy on all three ANLI rounds. The ablations further support the contribution of SMIC. We evaluate a real-valued Llama-style plug-in and extend deletion/insertion diagnostics to pretrained ModernBERT encoder and Llama decoder models with and without SMIC. translated_title: SMIC：面向自然语言推理的跨Transformer层共享多尺度输入-参考条件化方法
translated_abstract: 自然语言推理模型可能对局部词汇变化较为敏感。我们提出了共享多尺度输入-参考条件化（SMIC）方法，它构建一个单一的、依赖于输入的多尺度参考，并在Transformer各层之间重复使用。每一层对该共享参考应用各自的多尺度变换，并在注意力更新之前注入所得的条件化特征。我们在词元-上下文Transformer（TCT）中实例化了SMIC，并在全部三轮ANLI基准上与基于解码器的模型以及多层感知机（MLP）基线进行了从零训练的对比实验。TCT-SMIC在所有三轮ANLI上均取得了所观察到的最高的十次随机种子平均准确率。消融实验进一步验证了SMIC的贡献。我们还评估了一个实值Llama风格插件，并将删除/插入诊断实验扩展到带与不带SMIC的预训练ModernBERT编码器和Llama解码器模型上。在所评估的扰动协议中……
tldr: 本文提出SMIC方法，通过构建单一输入相关的多尺度参考并在Transformer各层间共享复用，显著提升了模型对局部词汇变化的鲁棒性，在全部三轮ANLI自然语言推理基准上取得了最高的十种子平均准确率。
